Second test build of Ionium, Celeritas running on Minecraft 1.8.9 Forge. Still a pre-release, so expect bugs and keep a backup of your worlds.

**Setup is the same as pre.1.** It needs Java 21, RetroFuturaBootstrap (we use [8to25](https://github.com/Oondanomala/8to25)) and LWJGL 3 from the launcher, plus ION Client for the LWJGL 2 compatibility layer. If something is missing, Ionium now shows a dialog at launch that tells you what, instead of crashing.

Fixes:
- Entities and block entities were drawn twice on Forge, and the second copy showed up on top of stained glass, water and ice.
- Chunk meshing now uses Forge's block layer hooks, so modded blocks that render in more than one layer or depend on the layer look right.
- Ionium no longer silently fails to load when 8to25 or ION Client already brought Mixin.

Performance:
- Fixed a bug in Forge's sky colour cache that made it resample the biomes around you several times per frame. At render distance 12: about 1000 → 1316 fps standing still, 970 → 1261 fps turning and 545 → 837 fps with lots of mobs.
- Fancy clouds are drawn from cached geometry instead of being rebuilt every frame. In a simple static scene this went from about 1650 to 4200 fps.
- Fewer GPU driver round trips per frame for fog and matrix state, which helps most on Mesa.

Known issues:
- Ionium doesn't show up in Forge's mod list yet. Check F3, it says "Ionium Renderer" on the right.
- The game once hung while saving on exit. We haven't been able to reproduce it since.

Based on Celeritas by embeddedt (LGPL-3.0). Not affiliated with CaffeineMC or the Celeritas project, so please report problems here.
